unlisted_practices: Event-driven sensing that activates on human presence rather than continuous raw-video recording, to limit data retention and privacy exposure
Privacy-aware local storage of structured pose data instead of raw video
Timestamp-based cross-modal synchronization of motion and meal events into behavioural episodes
Interpreting LLM meal-image output as coarse dietary context only, not precise nutritional quantification

screen.reason: The study deploys and tests a novel prototype system for home behavioral and dietary monitoring combining stereo vision, local event-driven sensing, and LLM-assisted meal-image interpretation in a real kitchen-dining environment. It evaluates technical system feasibility and performance rather than testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
